status: prospective finite development diagnostic; not G2 registration

environment.repair: reset one record to zero; irreversible damage flag remains
environment.sender: exact initial local receipt strings, no pending future fault label; G0 observation diagnostic only
environment.receiver: framed message and its own public action-observation history
environment.communication: one initial message per job; deterministic codec fixed within each phase

utility.horizon_exhaustion: failure unless explicit FINALIZE occurred; charge irreversible damage
utility.unit: dimensionless normalized utility; not seconds or measured currency

communication.compressed_codec_class: all 16 deterministic maps from four receipt observations to one symbol
communication.no_communication: empty payload with the same two-byte frame
communication.frame: uint8 version + uint8 payload length + ASCII bytes
communication.initial_deployment: version/length header + four codewords + two-byte acknowledgement; NC zero deployment
communication.migration: same codebook deployment bytes plus modeled extra update fee; atomic barrier between jobs
communication.model_learning_cost: not measured; extra update fee is a sensitivity parameter, not a training cost estimate

comparisons: all source-optimal one-symbol codecs retained, receiver optimally readapted
forced switch to target-optimal one-symbol codec, charged even if unnecessary
oracle option to retain or switch, with full range across source-optimal ties
best single one-symbol static codec for equally weighted source and target phases
fixed sufficient two-symbol codec, no retraining assumed
no communication with identical paid inspection access

analysis.arithmetic: exact fractions and finite-horizon belief-state dynamic programming
analysis.initial_state_distribution: enumerate all 12 count/fault combinations; no Monte Carlo error
analysis.tie_policy: all tied source codecs retained; lexical action order for deterministic rollout of equal-value policies
analysis.lifecycle: equal source and target job counts; initial deployment charged once, migration once
analysis.selected_cell_rule: C only, extra_update_fee=1 and jobs_per_phase=100; require worst-tie optional lifecycle advantage >1/50 over max(best static one-symbol, sufficient fixed, no communication), forced target gain >1/50, and zero hazard with success=1 for target oracle; among eligible choose smallest byte_cost then inspect_cost. If none, no selected cell; do not tune grid after seeing learning outcomes.
analysis.negative_regime: forced target gain<0; optional retention cannot be negative by definition
analysis.F_interpretation: frequency-only alternative mechanism, not an assumed null
analysis.stop: complete all cells; implementation defect invalidates affected results and is logged before rerun

validation: N/C identical initial distributions and scoring; F identical transitions to N
public TIMEOUT identical for pre-write and post-commit failures, but persistent hidden states differ
hidden future faults do not change sender inputs
exact solver checked by independent exhaustive rollout of saved receiver policies
independent SQLite transitions and multi-step trajectories, without calling finite step
actual frame and migration serialization, version rejection and equal-cost symbol rename
complete deterministic grid rerun and content hash comparison
claim_limits: oracle knows transition model and distribution; no learned language evolution or neural readiness
only one initial message; no learned chunks or dynamic dialogue
exact local receipts are privileged relative to noisy practical observations
all costs modeled in normalized utility; no actual network or model update timing
SQLite is an independent implementation check, not G3 learned transfer or real-tool adaptation
no container runtime available locally; do not claim Docker execution
